## Intro

Loop through all groups and refit the selected model from "01-fit-sdms-aic.qmd", estimate biomass index and include as SVC. 

## Load packages & source functions

```{r load libraries}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(tidylog)
library(RCurl)
library(devtools)
library(sdmTMB)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(here)

# Source code for map plots
devtools::source_url("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/maxlindmark/spatial-metabolic-index/main/R/functions/map-plot.R")
options(ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis")

# Set path
home <- here::here()
```

## Read data

```{r read data}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Read data
d <- read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/catch_clean.csv")) |>
  add_utm_columns(ll_names = c("lon", "lat")) |>
  mutate(life_stage = ifelse(str_ends(group, "juvenile"), "juvenile", "adult")) |>
  filter(!group %in% c("whiting_all", "turbot_all", "dab_all"))
```

## Scale variables

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

pred_grid <- bind_rows(
  read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(1_2).csv")),
  read_csv(paste0(home, "/data/clean/pred_grid_(2_2).csv"))
)

pred_grid <- pred_grid |>
  mutate(
    temp_sc = (temp - mean(temp)) / sd(temp),
    temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
    oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(oxy)) / sd(oxy),
    oxy_sq = oxy_sc^2,
    sal_sc = (sal - mean(sal)) / sd(sal),
    depth_sc = (depth - mean(depth)) / sd(depth),
    depth_sq = depth_sc * depth_sc,
    month_f = as.factor(month),
    year_f = as.factor(year)
  )

d <- d |>
  mutate(
    temp_sc = (temp - mean(pred_grid$temp)) / sd(pred_grid$temp),
    temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
    oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(pred_grid$oxy)) / sd(pred_grid$oxy),
    oxy_sq = oxy_sc^2,
    sal_sc = (sal - mean(pred_grid$sal)) / sd(pred_grid$sal),
    depth_sc = (depth - mean(pred_grid$depth)) / sd(pred_grid$depth),
    depth_sq = depth_sc * depth_sc,
    month_f = as.factor(month),
    year_f = as.factor(year)
  )

# Per-cell temporal min/median/max of temp/oxy (quarter 4), shared across all
# groups, used to build the low/median/high environment scenario grids below.
cell_env <- pred_grid |>
  filter(quarter == 4) |>
  summarise(
    sal_sc = median(sal_sc),
    depth_sc = first(depth_sc),
    depth_sq = first(depth_sq),
    temp_sc_min = min(temp_sc),
    temp_sc_p50 = quantile(temp_sc, 0.5),
    temp_sc_max = max(temp_sc),
    oxy_sc_min = min(oxy_sc),
    oxy_sc_p50 = quantile(oxy_sc, 0.5),
    oxy_sc_max = max(oxy_sc),
    .by = c(X, Y)
  )
```

## Fit the model that is preferred by the given group
Plot residuals, save model object, plot conditional effects!

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

fit_one <- function(rhs, priors, dd, mesh, spatial_varying = NULL) {
  form <- as.formula(paste0(
    "density ~ 0 + year_f + (1|month_f)",
    " + sal_sc + depth_sc + depth_sq + ", rhs
  ))
  fit <- sdmTMB(form,
    data = dd,
    mesh = mesh,
    family = tweedie(link = "log"),
    spatiotemporal = "iid",
    spatial = "on",
    spatial_varying = spatial_varying,
    time = "year",
    priors = priors
  )
  run_extra_optimization(fit)
}

# For making the counterfactual plot, I need to make a prediction. I don't want to
# have to select a given year, but predict for an average year. Since year_f is fixed,
# I need to manipulate the TMB object. In addition, I want to predict without epsilon.
# The approach is to solve for the random effects once using the TRUE b_j (original
# projection onto the new grid), then modify b_j in that already-solved parameter
# vector and call report(). report() doesn't optimise anything, so the random effects
# stay exactly as correctly solved, and only the fixed effect changes.
# This is validated in R/99-test-param-manipulation.R:

# Helper functions to do this inside the loop:
counterfactual_components <- function(m, newdata, neutralize_year = TRUE) {
  tmb_data <- predict(m, newdata = newdata, return_tmb_data = TRUE)
  obj <- TMB::MakeADFun(
    data = tmb_data, parameters = get_pars(m),
    map = m$tmb_map, random = m$tmb_random,
    DLL = "sdmTMB", silent = TRUE
  )
  obj$fn(m$model$par) # solve once, with the TRUE fitted parameters
  par <- obj$env$last.par.best

  if (neutralize_year) {
    n_year_terms <- sum(str_starts(tidy(m)$term, "year_f"))
    b_idx <- which(names(par) == "b_j")[seq_len(n_year_terms)]
    par[b_idx] <- mean(par[b_idx])
  }

  rep <- obj$report(par)
  # Note spatiotemporal random effects are omitted
  out <- newdata |>
    mutate(
      eta_fixed = rep$proj_fe[, 1],
      omega_s = rep$proj_omega_s_A[, 1],
      zeta_s = rep$proj_zeta_s_A[, 1, 1]
    )
  # Saved here so the code below can reuse this object instead of building and solving it again
  attr(out, "obj") <- obj
  out
}

combine_eta <- function(components, index_sc_val = NULL) {
  if (is.null(index_sc_val)) index_sc_val <- components$index_sc
  components |>
    mutate(
      index_sc = index_sc_val,
      # Note spatiotemporal random effects are omitted
      eta = as.vector(eta_fixed + omega_s + zeta_s * index_sc_val),
      est = exp(eta)
    )
}

# For the simulation-based uncertainty on occupancy transitions (net/gain/loss/turnover), 
# mirror what predict.sdmTMB(nsim > 0) does
# draw the joint (fixed + random effect) parameter vector from the joint precision,
# then report() each draw. comp_median/comp_env_low/comp_env_high share identical fitted
# parameters (only their proj_* projection matrices differ across newdata grids), so t_draws is
# drawn once per group and reported through all three objects.
n_sims <- 500

# This function gets the linear predictor omitting spatiotemporal random effects
eta_from_report <- function(rep, index_sc_val) {
  as.vector(rep$proj_fe[, 1] + rep$proj_omega_s_A[, 1] + rep$proj_zeta_s_A[, 1, 1] * index_sc_val)
}

# Reduces one occupied/not-occupied comparison to summaries, so the 500 gridded predictions are not stored
occ_delta <- function(occ_from, occ_to) {
  n_core <- sum(occ_from & occ_to)
  n_gain <- sum(!occ_from & occ_to)
  n_loss <- sum(occ_from & !occ_to)
  from_area <- n_core + n_loss
  tibble(
    gain = 100 * n_gain / from_area,
    loss = 100 * n_loss / from_area,
    net = 100 * (n_gain - n_loss) / from_area,
    turnover = 100 * (n_gain + n_loss) / n_core
  )
}

pred_list <- list()
pred_grid_list <- list()
res_list <- list()
coef_list <- list()
scenario_pred_list <- list()
occupancy_sims_list <- list()
#cog_list <- list()
eao_list <- list()
index_list <- list()

for (i in unique(d$group)) {
  dd <- d |> filter(group == i)

  mesh <- make_mesh(dd, xy_cols = c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 15)

  ggplot() +
    inlabru::gg(mesh$mesh) +
    coord_fixed() +
    geom_point(aes(X, Y), data = d, alpha = 0.2, size = 0.5) +
    annotate("text",
      label = paste(str_to_sentence(unique(dd$life_stage)), unique(dd$common_name)),
      x = -Inf, y = Inf, vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1,
      color = "gray40", size = 4
    ) +
    labs(x = "Easting (km)", y = "Northing (km)")

  ggsave(paste0(home, paste0("/figures/supp/mesh_", i, ".pdf")), width = 14, height = 14, units = "cm")

  # Fit the AIC-selected model, estimate a biomass index, refit with index as SVC
  bundle <- readRDS(paste0(home, "/output/model01_", i, ".rds"))

  m_base <- fit_one(bundle$rhs, bundle$priors, dd, mesh)

  ind <- get_index(m_base,
    newdata = pred_grid |> filter(quarter == 4),
    area = 3 * 3
  )
  # Scale instead of just center to make sd of SVC comparable to the scaled fixed effects
  ind <- ind |> mutate(index_sc = as.vector(scale(log_est)))

  # Add index to data and prediction grid
  dd_index <- dd |> left_join(ind |> dplyr::select(year, index_sc), by = "year")
  pred_grid_i <- pred_grid |> left_join(ind |> dplyr::select(year, index_sc), by = "year")

  # Refit model with scaled index as SVC
  m <- fit_one(bundle$rhs, bundle$priors, dd_index, mesh,
    spatial_varying = ~ 0 + index_sc
  )

  # Plot residuals
  res <- simulate(m, nsim = 300, type = "mle-mvn") |>
    dharma_residuals(m, plot = FALSE) |>
    mutate(group = i)

  # Store residuals
  res_list[[i]] <- res

  # Extract coefficients
  coef_list[[i]] <- bind_rows(
    tidy(m) |>
      filter(!str_starts(term, "year_f")) |>
      mutate(group = i),
    tidy(m, effects = "ran_pars") |>
      mutate(group = i)
  )

  # Create prediction dfs for conditional effects
  nd <- data.frame(expand.grid(
    temp = seq(min(dd$temp) - 4,
      max(dd$temp) + 4,
      length.out = 50
    ),
    oxy = seq(min(dd$oxy) - 4,
      max(dd$oxy) + 4,
      length.out = 50
    ),
    month = 11
  )) |>
    mutate(
      temp_sc = (temp - mean(pred_grid$temp)) / sd(pred_grid$temp),
      temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
      oxy_sc = (oxy - mean(pred_grid$oxy)) / sd(pred_grid$oxy),
      year = min(dd$year),
      year_f = as.factor(min(dd$year)),
      month_f = as.factor(month),
      sal_sc = 0,
      depth_sc = 0, depth_sq = 0,
      index_sc = 0,
      X = mean(dd$X),
      Y = mean(dd$Y),
      group = i
    )

  # Predict
  pred <- predict(m, newdata = nd, re_form = NA, re_form_iid = NA, se_fit = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      est = as.numeric(est),
      est_se = as.numeric(est_se)
    )

  pred_list[[i]] <- pred

  # Predict on grid
  p <- predict(m, newdata = pred_grid_i) |> mutate(group = i)

  pred_grid_list[[i]] <- p

  # Manipulated predictions for counterfactual scenarios. 
  index_low <- min(dd_index$index_sc, na.rm = TRUE)
  index_med <- median(dd_index$index_sc, na.rm = TRUE)
  index_high <- max(dd_index$index_sc, na.rm = TRUE)

  anchor_year <- min(dd$year) # any real fitted year; its year_f contribution
  # is chanaged to the mean anyway for the environment/index axes below
  yf_levels <- levels(dd_index$year_f)
  mf_levels <- levels(dd_index$month_f)

  make_nd <- function(temp_sc, oxy_sc) {
    cell_env |>
      mutate(
        temp_sc = temp_sc,
        temp_sq = temp_sc^2,
        oxy_sc = oxy_sc,
        year = anchor_year,
        year_f = factor(anchor_year, levels = yf_levels),
        month = 11,
        month_f = factor(11, levels = mf_levels),
        index_sc = 0 # placeholder only: needed for model.frame() to build
        # tmb_data (the SVC formula references index_sc), but its value here
        # is never used. eta is recomputed from zeta_s * the real index_sc
        # values afterward, via combine_eta()
      )
  }

  comp_median <- counterfactual_components(m, make_nd(cell_env$temp_sc_p50, cell_env$oxy_sc_p50))
  comp_env_low <- counterfactual_components(m, make_nd(cell_env$temp_sc_max, cell_env$oxy_sc_min))
  comp_env_high <- counterfactual_components(m, make_nd(cell_env$temp_sc_min, cell_env$oxy_sc_max))

  scenario_pred <- bind_rows(
    combine_eta(comp_median, index_med) |> mutate(scenario = "environment", level = "median"),
    combine_eta(comp_env_low, index_med) |> mutate(scenario = "environment", level = "low"),
    combine_eta(comp_env_high, index_med) |> mutate(scenario = "environment", level = "high"),
    combine_eta(comp_median, index_med) |> mutate(scenario = "index", level = "median"),
    combine_eta(comp_median, index_low) |> mutate(scenario = "index", level = "low"),
    combine_eta(comp_median, index_high) |> mutate(scenario = "index", level = "high"),
    combine_eta(comp_median, index_med) |> mutate(scenario = "joint", level = "median"),
    combine_eta(comp_env_low, index_low) |> mutate(scenario = "joint", level = "low"),
    combine_eta(comp_env_high, index_high) |> mutate(scenario = "joint", level = "high")
  ) |>
    mutate(group = i)

  scenario_pred_list[[i]] <- scenario_pred

  # Simulation-based uncertainty on the occupancy transitions (net/gain/loss/turnover).
  # comp_median/env_low/env_high are the same fitted model projected onto different grids, 
  # (the t_draws is the same for all three and used in $report)
  obj_median <- attr(comp_median, "obj")
  obj_env_low <- attr(comp_env_low, "obj")
  obj_env_high <- attr(comp_env_high, "obj")

  # Get SEs of fitted model
  sd_report_joint <- m$sd_report

  # Draw simulated parameter estimates
  t_draws <- sdmTMB:::rmvnorm_prec(
    mu = obj_median$env$last.par.best, tmb_sd = sd_report_joint, n_sims = n_sims
  )

  # Change year_f to mean in every draw the same way as the point estimate
  # (average across year_f within that draw, not the point estimate's mean)
  n_year_terms <- sum(str_starts(tidy(m)$term, "year_f"))
  b_idx <- which(names(obj_median$env$last.par.best) == "b_j")[seq_len(n_year_terms)]
  col_means <- colMeans(t_draws[b_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  t_draws[b_idx, ] <- rep(col_means, each = length(b_idx))

  draws <- purrr::array_branch(t_draws, margin = 2)
  rep_median <- purrr::map(draws, obj_median$report)
  rep_env_low <- purrr::map(draws, obj_env_low$report)
  rep_env_high <- purrr::map(draws, obj_env_high$report)

  occupancy_sims_list[[i]] <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_sims), function(s) {
    # Threshold recomputed per draw (5% of max)
    est_median_s <- exp(eta_from_report(rep_median[[s]], index_med))
    thresh_s <- 0.05 * max(est_median_s)

    est_env_low_s <- exp(eta_from_report(rep_env_low[[s]], index_med))
    est_env_high_s <- exp(eta_from_report(rep_env_high[[s]], index_med))
    est_index_low_s <- exp(eta_from_report(rep_median[[s]], index_low))
    est_index_high_s <- exp(eta_from_report(rep_median[[s]], index_high))

    bind_rows(
      occ_delta(est_env_high_s >= thresh_s, est_env_low_s >= thresh_s) |>
        mutate(scenario = "environment"),
      occ_delta(est_index_low_s >= thresh_s, est_index_high_s >= thresh_s) |>
        mutate(scenario = "index")
    ) |>
      mutate(sim_index = s)
  }) |>
    mutate(group = i)

  # Estimate index, cog and eao
  nd_real <- pred_grid_i |> filter(year %in% unique(dd$year) & quarter == 4)

  index_list[[i]] <- get_index(m, newdata = nd_real, area = 3 * 3) |>
    mutate(group = i)

  # cog_list[[i]] <- get_cog(m, newdata = nd_real, format = "wide") |>
  #   mutate_at(c("est_x", "lwr_x", "upr_x", "est_y", "lwr_y", "upr_y"), ~ . * 1000) |>
  #   mutate(group = i)

  eao_list[[i]] <- get_eao(m, newdata = nd_real) |>
    mutate(group = i)
}

# Save predictions
preds <- dplyr::bind_rows(pred_list)
preds_grid <- dplyr::bind_rows(pred_grid_list)
res <- dplyr::bind_rows(res_list)
coef <- dplyr::bind_rows(coef_list)
scenario_preds <- dplyr::bind_rows(scenario_pred_list)
occupancy_sims <- dplyr::bind_rows(occupancy_sims_list)
index <- dplyr::bind_rows(index_list)
#cogs <- dplyr::bind_rows(cog_list)
eaos <- dplyr::bind_rows(eao_list)
```

```{r}
write_csv(res, paste0(home, "/output/residuals_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(preds, paste0(home, "/output/conditional_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(preds_grid, paste0(home, "/output/pred_grids_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(coef, paste0(home, "/output/coefs_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(scenario_preds, paste0(home, "/output/scenario_preds_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(occupancy_sims, paste0(home, "/output/occupancy_sims_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(index, paste0(home, "/output/index_02_sdms.csv"))
#write_csv(cogs, paste0(home, "/output/cogs_02_sdms.csv"))
write_csv(eaos, paste0(home, "/output/eaos_02_sdms.csv"))
```

## Plot residuals

```{r}
# Plot residuals
res |>
  separate(group, into = c("common_name", "life_stage"), sep = "_", remove = FALSE) |>
  mutate(group2 = paste(str_to_sentence(life_stage), common_name)) |>
  ggplot(aes(observed, expected)) +
  geom_point(color = "grey30", shape = 21, size = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(col = "tomato3", linewidth = 0.6) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~group2) +
  labs(x = "Observed", y = "Expected")

ggsave(paste0(home, "/figures/supp/qq_sdm_02.pdf"), width = 17, height = 14, units = "cm")
```
